title: The bench, repainted
logline: The seawall bench repainted by the town, wet green, a WET PAINT card the page doesn't letter, and the crow on the wall keeping off it. The pup sitting on the pavement instead of under. Everyone displaced by a color.

panels.composition: A seawall bench freshly painted green with a paper card hung on it, a crow on the wall beside it, a small three-legged dog sitting on the pavement instead of beneath the bench.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall bench freshly painted green with a paper card hung on it, a crow on the wall beside it and a small three-legged dog sitting on the pavement instead of beneath the bench, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
